from inspect import signature
from starlette.responses import JSONResponse

def build_endpoint(handler, response_model=None):
    parameters = signature(handler).parameters
    dependant = get_dependant(call=handler, path="/")

    async def endpoint(request):
        solved = await solve_dependencies(
            request=request,
            dependant=dependant,
            body=await request.json(),
        )
        if solved.errors:
            raise RequestValidationError(solved.errors)
        result = await handler(**solved.values)
        data = serialize_response(response_model, result)
        return JSONResponse(data)

    return endpoint

def align_rows(left, right, fill_value=None):
    index = left.index.union(right.index, sort=False)
    left_indexer = left.index.get_indexer(index)
    right_indexer = right.index.get_indexer(index)

    left_values = take_with_fill(left, left_indexer, fill_value)
    right_values = take_with_fill(right, right_indexer, fill_value)
    return left_values, right_values, index

def group_values(frame, key):
    codes, uniques = factorize(frame[key], sort=False)
    for code, label in enumerate(uniques):
        yield label, frame.iloc[codes == code]
